notes.name: Mount Beroegoles

notes.name: Cherval
notes.legend: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 54°C.

notes.name: Monzanoviara Enchanted Reservoir
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

notes.name: Trilza — copper mining town
notes.legend: Trilza is a mining town of 191 people just nearby the copper mine.

notes.name: The Honest Mule
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious jugged mule with green spirits is served here.

notes.name: Viazhesk Monster
notes.legend: Tales say a relic monster of 11 ft long inhabits Viazhesk Lake. Truth or lie, folks are afraid to fish in the lake.

notes.name: Redclif Monster
notes.legend: Old sailors tell stories of a gigantic sea monster inhabiting these dangerous waters. Rumors say it can be 16 ft long.

notes.name: Tricaro Giant
notes.legend: Legends speak of a hungry Giant who inhabits Tricaro hills and attacks unsuspecting victims.

notes.name: Ternovech Hag
notes.legend: Tales speak of a superior Hag who inhabits Ternovech hills and keeps the region at bay.

notes.legend:

notes.name: Kala Cave
notes.legend: The Kala Cave. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

notes.name: Sadere Cemetery
notes.legend: This ethereal necropolis seems suspended between the realms of the living and the dead. Wisps of mist dance around the tombstones, while haunting melodies linger in the air, commemorating the departed.

notes.name: Chales Crypt
notes.legend: A towering necropolis adorned with macabre sculptures and guarded by formidable undead sentinels. Its ancient halls house the remains of fallen heroes, entombed alongside their cherished relics.
